q1_what_did_you_play: I played all four cards: Bang Bang! first, spending the 2 Sparks, then both Kaboom! cards on Shrinker Beetle, then Duck and Cover. This uses all 3 energy and both Sparks, deals 24 printed damage to the single enemy, and gains 5 Block.
q2_other_line_considered: I considered skipping Duck and Cover and playing only Bang Bang! and the two Kaboom! cards, since the enemy’s printed intent is a Debuff rather than an attack and the extra energy would otherwise be unused. I rejected it because Duck and Cover is affordable and has no printed downside.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up the option to leave 1 energy unused and to keep the 2 Sparks unspent, and it did not kill Shrinker Beetle, leaving it at 16 HP. It gave up no in-turn damage or block compared with any other affordable line.
q4_different_intent: No. A different telegraphed intent would not have changed the play, because every card in hand is affordable and has no printed downside; the line already includes both damage and block.
